data.observations: One real source-selected endpoint completed with both pinned checkers accepting. The local identity/process adapter passed the clean baseline and rejected four fixed controls. Native Comparator reported success for a no-op configured Nanoda command, a valid alternate target and a valid changed supporting proof; it has no stale-receipt interface. The offline freshness control rejected historical success for a new execution request. Baseline and changed exports contain40520 declared constant names and the same three permitted axioms.
data.limitations: E0 integration signal, not a confirmed defect, kernel-correctness result, mathematical-meaning judgment, historical-execution claim or independent holdout. Native configuration/executable trust is explicit. Export inventory binds the entire checking environment, not a minimal theorem closure. Early setup/inventory failures and interrupted emulated/host-mounted attempts were repaired and retained; no verdict is inferred from them. Stale-control true invocation fields describe the old baseline only; no fresh native run occurred.
data.decision: Retain the small adapter for normal-priority future LAL Comparator receipts, requiring an independent trusted request, exact config/source/export/checker identities and actual fresh completion. No upstream issue, PR, automatic E1 confirmation or sample expansion follows. Select a separate small symbolic-universe K screen READY and unstarted; preserve transfer intake gates and deferred S work.
